featured_reviews.name: Exploreonmind
featured_reviews.review_text:
A refreshing café experience at Bread Bar with their seasonal mango menu.
The menu creatively incorporates mango into both savoury and sweet dishes. The avocado toast with mango and jalapeños stood out for its balance of flavours, while the mango cheesecake was smooth and well crafted.
The beverages especially the mango matcha and mango passion fruit lemonade were refreshing and complemented the meal well.
The ambience is modern and minimal, making it a great place to relax or enjoy a casual outing.
Overall, a well curated menu with a seasonal twist worth a visit.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

If you needed a sign to dive into strawberry season, this is it 🍓

Visited The Bread Bar, Chembur and the café already feels like Christmas. Warm lights, cozy vibes, and a strawberry menu that completely stole the show.

Tried their special strawberry menu and every item was a hit. The Strawberry Milkshake was creamy, fresh, and the perfect start. The Gingerbread Pancake genuinely tastes like Christmas morning. The Strawberry Nutella Toast was so good we were obsessed from the first bite.

The Strawberry Tres Leches deserves a special mention, soft, indulgent, and perfectly balanced. And the Strawberry Doughnut was soft, fluffy, and a solid 10/10.

To top it all off, their Hot Chocolate with Marshmallows is pure comfort in a cup.

Overall, the menu feels warm, fun, nostalgic, and just makes you happy. If you are in Chembur, The Bread Bar is a must visit. Highly recommend trying their strawberry menu.

featured_reviews.name: Ritika
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried The Bread Bar and had a great experience. We ordered the chicken parm sandwich and the grilled chicken sandwich, and we loved both of them.

The chicken parm sandwich was delicious — perfectly crispy chicken with great sauce and cheese, all packed into fresh, well-toasted bread. It was really satisfying and full of flavor.

The grilled chicken sandwich was just as good. The chicken was juicy and well-seasoned, and the sandwich felt fresh and well-balanced overall.

Everything tasted high quality and well-prepared. I’d definitely come back to try more from the menu.

Soft lighting, comfortable seating, and calming music set the perfect mood to relax, work, or just unwind with a cup of coffee. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee hits you the moment you walk in, and every sip feels comforting. The staff is friendly and welcoming, making the place feel even more homely. Whether you’re catching up with friends, reading a book, or enjoying some quiet me-time, this café gives you that snug, feel-good vibe you’ll want to come back to again and again. 🩷☕.

featured_reviews.name: Heena Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst café experience so far. I ordered the mango lemon doughnut, fruit & nut chia seed pudding, and masala chai. Within less than a minute of ordering, I requested to cancel the chai, but the staff refused and said it couldn’t be cancelled — ₹250 for single chai!!!

The fruit & nut chia seed pudding was honestly one of the worst I’ve had. But the worst part was the mango lemon doughnut from their special mango menu. Since it’s mango season, I was excited to try it, but it was extremely disappointing. The filling inside tasted like raw egg yolk with an overpowering eggy smell and flavour. It was so unpleasant that I actually felt sick after eating it. There was barely any sweetness, no proper lemon flavour, and the overall taste was just horrible.

On top of that, they charged ₹85 as service charge for such poor food and service. Completely not worth the money. Worst taste, worst service, and a total waste of money.
